profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Playful and pleased to see his people, three-year-old Scooby illustrates one rescue’s account of a Bull Mastweiler, a Bullmastiff–Rottweiler cross. He understood several commands, waited patiently for food and barked to greet visitors. When tired or excited, he could jump up and mouth people, showing how exuberance and strength can combine.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: Scooby’s rescue account pairs playful greetings and patient food waits with strong, excitable jumping and mouthing.
